title: Tying wagons together and winning Joe Oliver
summary: Black Benny tied wagons; Oliver was beaten and joined Ory, who corrected his tone.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Is it true that sometimes they used to lock the wheels together?
Is it true that they used to lock the wheels of the wagons together sometimes?

Black Benning used to tie them with rope, you know. Oh, Black Benning. They wouldn't lock them, they'd lock them. They'd take a rope. Oh, rope. The other guy would try to get away from them and drag along with them. That's cool.
In fact, wasn't that the way you got hold of Joe Oliver?
Yeah. Yeah, we tied lock with Joe. He had all kinds of band. He's on band, huh? Mm-hmm. What happened? Well, he got beat so bad. Got beat so bad, he happened to for a job.

So I told him he'd take him on if he'd listened to him and let him correct his tone and so forth. And he did. And when he got to be sounding so wonderfully, that he'd crown him king from there on in. Did you crown him king? Yeah.
